caption: The drawing features a single object: a figurine shaped like a sitting rabbit positioned in profile facing left. The rabbit is painted primarily in a light tan color with brown speckles distributed throughout its body. Its ear interiors and the area around its nostrils and mouth are highlighted in a pinkish-red tone. The eye is yellow with a central black dot. There is a large dark brown spot on the hindquarters and a smaller yellow patch with black circles on the upper foreleg. The base on which the rabbit is sitting is rectangular with a narrow band of gold on the left and a red patch on the front corner. The background is plain, light beige, and unadorned. In the lower right corner of the page, the name “STANLEY MAZUR” is printed in small uppercase letters.
title: Chalkware Rabbit
